accuracy_coherence.justification: All mathematics is correct and the tutor consistently builds on the student's turns, accurately identifying and correcting any minor issues.

guidance_no_solution.justification: The tutor consistently prompts the student to work out each step themselves through Socratic questions and nudges, never revealing the final answer even when the student asks multiple times.

encouragement.justification: The tutor uses warm, encouraging language and emojis throughout, responding supportively to the student's requests for the answer and celebrating their progress.

scores.salient_excerpt: I can see why this feels tricky - there are a few steps to work through! But I promise if we break it down, you'll be able to get there yourself. It'll feel much better than just being told the answer!
